name: Top 10 Rankings
epitaph: WIA’s own staff ranked its top ten wrestlers with a paragraph of commentary apiece — praising roleplays, noting who’d stepped up and who was still waiting to debut. One clean edition survives whole, dated January 2003. A second, undated Top 10 sidebar survives on the fed’s own later news/front page (Wayback-captured 26 March 2003, bounded no earlier than 20 January 2003): eight names carry over, Spastic and AAH drop out, and David Valdez and Hunter Tazi appear for the first time — consistent with Spastic’s own move from wrestler to owner on 26 January — but nothing dates that second list precisely enough to ledger it as its own year-bestowal alongside the first, so it stands as prose here rather than a second row.

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Pyro — “impressed us these past couple weeks with his excellent roleplays and in-card segments... As a World Title contender this superstar has a bright future in WIA.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Steve Jackson — “about right on the line with Pyro with his great roleplays, he picked up a good win on Insanity... another top World Title contender.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: 8 Ball — “probably the most active wrestler we have... became the victor in the main event on Insanity and also made a name for himself as the ‘enforcer’ of WIA.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Jerms — “Another World Title contender, and a great superstar... his excellent roleplays got him in a last minute match on Insanity which he came out the winner.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Hein Bloeck — “one of our top roleplayers and has shown some serious potential to the WIA staff, as also a contender to the World Title.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Spastic — “had a tough break on Insanity but that didn’t cause him to slack off at all... he’s a real character and could lead WIA.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Joey Castellano — “may not be in the top 5 but this guy will prove to the world what he can actually do... not being in tourny will cause him to step it up even more.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Teal Shinto — “yet to make his WIA debut, but he will be in the tourny... has proved to be worthy of becoming champion.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: AAH (“Hero”) — “a great superstar and impressed us with his roleplays... we believe he will be probably the most unstoppable force in WIA.”

bestowals.source: WIA’s own Rankings, January 2003, served whole at /promotions/wia/archive/rankings-2003-01.html (Wayback-captured 24 January 2003).
bestowals.vote_detail: As billed: Kris Red — “yet to make his debut but his roleplays have impressed us, he just signed right before these rankings were made and he landed the 10 spot!”
